data.opportunityTitle: HIV Care Grant Program - Part B States/Territories Formula and AIDS Drug Assistance Program Formula and AIDS Drug Assistance Program Supplemental Awards
data.modifiedComments: Updated Estimated Post and Application Due Date

topAgencyDetails.agencyName: Department of Health and Human Services

forecast.forecastDesc: The purpose of this program is to provide funding to states and territories to develop and/or enhance access to a comprehensive system of high-quality HIV care and treatment for low-income people with HIV.
forecast.applicantEligibilityDesc: You can apply if:The 50 states, the District of Columbia, Guam, the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands are eligible to apply for Ryan White HIV/AIDS Program Part B Base, AIDS Drug Assistance Program Base, and Minority AIDS Initiative funding.The Northern Mariana Islands, American Samoa, the Federated States of Micronesia, the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the Republic of Palau are eligible to apply for Ryan White HIV/AIDS Program Base, AIDS Drug Assistance Program Base and Minority AIDS Initiative funding under Notice of Funding Opportunity HRSA-27-064.
forecast.estApplicationResponseDateDesc: Electronically submitted applications must be submitted no later than 11:59 p.m., ET, on the listed application due date.
forecast.modComments: updated Cost Sharing or Matching Requirement on Grants.gov Forecast.
